answer: To register, lock a shale bond: 80 POA for the first identity from a funder, 160 for the second, 240 for the third, rising 80 per extra key. Each epoch a random mirror auditor sends a nonce; sign it within 1 epoch and post it to a public mirror log. Miss twice and 50% burns; duplicates freeze both keys. Rewards drip as nectar over 6 epochs, one-sixth per epoch, forfeited if slashed. One fake risks 80 POA; ten lock 4,400 POA for at most 250 back; a hundred lock 404,000 POA. Wealth can still pay, so this caps capital, not personhood.
